svg.title: Springtrail captured on the DE10-Lite: the title, Start, the run and jumps to the goal, WON, a restart and the fall that ends in RETRY, every frame read back from the board over UART
svg.text: Springtrail · the image the repository builds · frames captured on the DE10-Lite over UART
Start+B+Right (161): spawn at x 24, B+Right (33) held
Runs right; the camera follows past x 72
A held (49): the jump over the first gap
Lands, then A held (49) over the patrol
A for one VBlank: a low hop over the second gap
Lands at x 399 and walks under the brick
A held (49): the jump over the third gap
Camera clamps at 608; the goal is in view
B+Right (33) runs into the first gap
Frames captured on the board during a frame_proofs.py showcase session; wiki/showcase/README.md records it.
